Title: A Roller Coaster Worth Riding

I’ve been with Viral Vamp for about a year and a half after investing $30,000 for them to start and operate a “Fulfilled by Amazon” store for me. The journey has definitely been a roller coaster — things started off slow, and there were a few bumps along the way. That said, my experience has been positive overall.

Viral Vamp is absolutely a legitimate company. They’ve delivered on their promise, and my store is now generating very good income. It required patience and trust in the process, but the results have been worth it.

If you’re considering working with them, know that it may not be an overnight success story — but with time, it can become a profitable one.

Paid $37,048 – No Sales, No Communication, No Fulfillment

On March 6, 2025, I paid $30,000 to Viral Vamp, LLC for their Amazon automation program. On July 3, 2025, I paid an additional $7,048 for inventory. The agreement and FTC Earnings Claim Disclosure provided at signing promised store setup, product listings, ongoing management, and performance reporting.

To date, no sales have been generated. I have received no consistent communication or reporting despite multiple requests for updates. I sent a formal refund demand letter and have filed complaints with the FTC and Florida Attorney General based on potential violations of the Florida Deceptive and Unfair Trade Practices Act and the FTC Business Opportunity Rule.

I am seeking a full refund of $37,048 due to complete non-performance of contractual obligations. I have provided documentation of the contract, disclosures, payment records, and correspondence to support my complaint.

I urge other consumers to proceed with caution and verify results before making any payment to this company.

For anyone seeking a stress-free way to generate passive income and make their money work for them, I wholeheartedly recommend Viral Vamp.

With the thought of earning a passive income and after talking with Griffen who sounded genuine and trust worthy, I took a leap of faith with some extra funds that i had saved to start the Amazon shop with Viral Vamp not knowing anything about it but the experience has been phenomenon, starting from onboarding where Ana was very helpful and provided step by step SOP which was really easy to follow with clear instructions. The initial start up for a newbe is slow with LLC creation, mailbox set up , cards etc and Viral Vamp has been very patient, guiding you in ever step. Whitney and Rimma who manage my Shop also have been very responsive and addressing every concern for the FBM store and are committed to increase sales..I would want to start another store next year with the experience i have had so far.

Overall a very good experience - the company is evolving and growing well. The management is genuine and the team is working hard - I look forward to building a successful business with ViralVamp and accelerating growth in 2025

Viral Vamp. Great business the team they have to run your businese stays on top of what is selling and takes care of any issues with the vendors and they have great communication with you.Everyone from JJhal to Griffen to the computer techs are top notch professionals.I would recommend them to anyone wanting to do a online store.

My experience with Brady at Viral Vamp has been extremely positive. My wife and I are approaching retirement and needed a plan to supplement our pensions and Social Security. Viral Vamp is providing passive income that is allowing us to live comfortably. The onboarding process was a little longer than I expected but well worth it. VV is very transparent and the communication skills are unmatched. If you are considering a hands off passive income business, I highly recommend VV.
I think viral vamp has been highly helpful and look forward to a long relationship with them

Overall 4.5 stars, it has been a good experience working with Viral Vamp.  I have been working with them since May.  Griffin was great to work with from the start and was a big reason in me choosing to go with Viral Vamp over the competitors.  Once I signed up it took about a month or so to get the store up and running and ready to purchase inventory.  I ended up with an item that had really good margins at 30% and has been consistently selling but a little slower than we had hoped.  But overall a lot of profit each month, I think my first purchase was $27k and should net around $8-9k (over about 5/6 month period).  If you are looking for some side income then Viral Vamp has definitely produced in that area.  It’s fun to watch the sales come as you still get to login into your account and watch the magic happen. 

The only thing keeping them from a 5 star review is I have told them multiple times I am ready to buy more and ramp up fast, as I have more capital available than the inventory I already bought.  So in 7 months I still have only spent about 15% of the capital I had available for my Amazon store.  I get that they have a lot of other clients to attend to but if anyone out there thinks they can come in and get rich right away it's more of a slow burn.  I think 98% of people won’t be in my situation and will be more than happy with the results!  

So in summary, great company to work with, Griffin is the best, just expect some time to get your business up and running and a good amount of time to ramp it up to huge amounts of money.

I signed with Viral Vamp about a year and a half ago.  It took a little of time to get it all launched but they were in communication with me the entire time.  I worked with Griffon to get started, Anna for onboarding & Jhill is now my account manager.  My store is up & running and healthy. Everyone I worked with was very professional and timely with their responses to any of my questions.  I have nothing but good things to say about my experience thus far with Viral Vamp.

My experience with Viral Vamp has been exceptional and very satisfactory so far. I decided to partner with Viral Vamp after researching and interviewing many companies. Brady was on the spot addressing all my concerns and provided a very realistic view of timeline, inventory, and growth for my account. Obviously, it took time to set up the store initially, but it has been smoother transactions for me ever since. I am constantly communicating with team, especially my account manager Jhill who keeps me updated on all fronts. No business is successful without proper communication and collaboration, and Viral Vamp is staying on top of my business in all aspects like researching the benefited product, inventory, and profit margins. I also noticed a negative review on the business profile, and it is completely unfair to the whole Viral Vamp team and partners as the entire team strategy is nothing but a successful business and ROI for partners like me. I am very convinced of potential growth for my FBA store within the coming months as I have the right teams like Brady and Jhill by my side who are providing me with all insight, tools, and systems to succeed. I am incredibly grateful for their support, time and efforts and recommend them to my friends and family.

I have a construction background so this was all new to me.  Initial set up went very smooth.  My questions were answered quickly and completely.  Start up took a little longer than I thought it was going to but they were in total communication with me to explain it.  My store is doing good now and I assume it’s only gonna get better.  Overall experience has been great so far.  Zero complaints.

Please keep reading. I am a very seasoned business person in my 60s and I’ve owned quite a few businesses. I am very familiar with direct sales and also have owned regular retail stores and at this particular point in time I still own 4 other businesses.
The team members that I have been involved with have been very helpful and very knowledgeable. The only downfall I see at this level is that the communication is very sporadic. After talking to Griffin, mostly is an issue that I am very hands-on and this business, for the investor is not so much hands-on. They do everything. so things are running in the background that I did not know about. Secondly, the start up time was unfortunately quite a bit longer than I had anticipated. I did not have any problems at all with the LLC, or taxation and revenue as I am already in business so the extra length of time, for all of that was very confusing and annoying. But of course, we made it through all of that. Thirdly, the inventory dollar amount required to get started was considerably higher than I was initially led to believe. Fortunately, I have the means to do that, however, when you’re first getting started and have no idea if a particular product is, a great seller, I had reticence about investing that amount of money in one product. Now for the great great news is the thing is selling, amazingly well and have already turned a rather tidy amount of money just in 2 selling months. I just gave approval to order a whole new line of products and anticipate the ones we are selling now will need to be re-ordered in the next 4 to 6 weeks.  Additionally, I work with another company with the exact same business model as viral vamp. I can honestly say that it has been the same very rough start up ride with them. I think they are overwhelmed with the amount of people they are working with and just don’t have the resources I would like to see to stay in constant communication. They are very easy to contact though!

Viral vamp is a scam. They took my money and lied. It took 10 months to build the store. Paid for the inventory and they kept the money. After 1 year, I spent 11k on the build and $4600 for inventory. I received $2100 total in return. This is a scam. After talking to Andrew their accountant I was told if everything goes perfect I will make a $400 profit. Everything isn’t going well. They lied about every single detail of this business. Scam, scam, scam. Please, don’t waste your time and money with this scam.

I've been with Viral Vamp for a number of years and at first, my experience with the company in my opinion was slow moving. After a few months, it slowly picked up and now I'm in a great position for me and my family to thrive in this business. Much appreciated to the Viral Vamp staff.

Exceptional Onboarding and Support – Highly Recommend Viral Vamp!

My experience with Viral Vamp has been nothing short of fantastic. The onboarding process was smooth and stress-free, thanks to Ana’s attentive support. She made sure everything was set up correctly from the start and was always available to answer any questions I had.

Buying my first round of inventory was also a breeze. The detailed video of the warehouse helped me understand the process clearly, and I felt confident knowing my products were in good hands.

Jhill, my account manager, has been outstanding. The communication has been excellent, and I’ve always felt supported every step of the way. Whenever I’ve needed help or had questions, Jhill has been quick to respond and provide insightful solutions.

The process of tracking my inventory and monitoring sales on Amazon has been seamless. The interface makes it easy to view key statistics, and I’ve found the system to be very user-friendly, which has made managing my business so much simpler.

Overall, Viral Vamp has been a game-changer for me. Their team, tools, and systems have made running my business much easier. I highly recommend them!

I have been working with Viral Vamp since February 2024.  It took about 6 months to get things off the ground, but I just made my first inventory purchase and am looking forward to beginning to see sales and profits.  I want to thank Griffin for bringing me on, Ana for working to onboard my store, and Whitney my account manager.  Thus far, everyone has been super helpful, and I can't wait to see my store grow and scale.  I will give a follow-up/update my review after a few months of sales with a progress report.

I work in healthcare management and started working with viral vamp in e-commerce as an additional revenue stream.  It’s been a little over a year now and I’m quite pleased how things have turned out. The team sets realistic expectations, operates with integrity and is clear with communications.  The hardest part was getting through the initial few months as the business was getting started.  With the team’s support we were able to successfully scale with ongoing success.  I’m impressed with the company, proud to contribute to its success and excited to be part of this journey.

Brady from Viral Vamp LLC is always attentive to the performance of our partnership. The management of my account by JHill is exceptional. We are always in communication, and sales have improved month by month, with ROI surpassing any other business."
I started last year with Viral Vamp and I am very satisfied with my store's progress.  The communication with my account rep. Has been consistent and helpful towards reaching my longterm goals.
